requested_mechanism: Independent source branch from retained006. Implement persistent query tiles per shared KV head for BF16 noncausal exact SINGLE_KV D128 only, with originalM128/N256, numerical expressions/guards and singleFP16 PV unchanged. One program owns a(batch,KVhead), loads originalK and convertsV once, then loops over its G query heads and ceil(S/128) query blocks, using explicit row/head formulas and unique output ownership; target32 programs*16 querytiles. Keep the loadedK/V tensors outside the querytile loop; Q loads, QK, FP32softmax, PV/output each iteration. No new global scratch/extra launch, no precision/tiling/compiler-option changes. Main target symbol remains _gqa_fwd_kernel; can use constexpr branch or preserve old implementation as a clearly reviewed fallback for other metadata. Original four other paths must preserve arithmetic and full-call contract. This tests per-KVhead persistent reuse; compiler may rematerialize/copy or exceed UB due to longer lifetimes, retain actual IR/negative result. Report honest tradeoff32program occupancy versus512 and whether generated loop hoists K/V. Never cache across calls.
analysis: 006主329.446594μs，512Cubeprogram与1024AIV；每programGM→L1224KiB（全112MiB）、每AIVGM→UB128KiB，目标V仅2MiB但共享KV头切片被G8×querytile2=16个program重读转换。当前009/016尝试V位置，009357.02675、016350.6339μs；012集中V转换虽主317.806366、aux5.040101μs，但完整346.6959μs，额外阶段负担真实保留。013每头V重排344.8088μs负结果；015M256splitQK因3Dconcat降为UB3146016B编译失败，单独IR编译修复进行。当前另选不增M也不增launch的persistent复用：每program固定(batch,kvhead)，一次加载K和一次转换V，循环该KVhead对应全部queryheads与querytiles，M128N256各次数值表达式保持。目标gridB4×NKV8=32program，对20Cube有至少一波并行，但相较512program总任务数降低，跨querytile是否形成流水由后端决定。预测静态跨program重复K/V可减少16倍，QK/softmax/PV总算术和L0C总量保持；每querytile同步链仍在，吞吐改善可能有限且32program负载均衡或跨迭代同步会退步。实际IR应把K/V load与BF16→FP16转换放在querytile循环外，若后端保留共享tensor导致UB超限或重新拷贝则保存具体事实。当前profiling/源码IR已足以提出复用假设，宿主保留历史模拟器知识，此调用无新模拟器前置输入；完整候选仍后profiling与重放。用源码先表达固定KVhead复用，后续是否进入IR由实际hoist/buffer/sync问题决定。完整原四项checker/计时复用，不扩新测试，不逐轮ABBA。
